title: A Stopped cloud run that the provider then FAILS pops the error dialog
description: Follow-up to MPI-928: after send a Stop keeps waiting, but a provider failure then settles through _settleError and shows 'Cloud generation failed' for a run the user already Stopped (seen 2026-09-26, nano-banana-2-cloud, Google 400). Nothing billed, nothing to keep: settle cancelled, log only.
